record.paper_title: Problemas abiertos en series de Fourier de Jacobi-Sobolev
record.context_brief: Magnitude estimates for non-discrete Jacobi-Sobolev polynomials
record.original_question: Consider the non-discrete Sobolev inner product <f,g> = integral f(x)g(x)dmu_0(x) + integral f'(x)g'(x)dmu_1(x). In the Jacobi-Sobolev case where mu_0=mu_1 is the Jacobi weight, let Q_n be the monic orthogonal polynomials for this inner product and let P_n^(alpha,beta) be the Jacobi polynomials. Determine whether estimates exist for Q_n and determine their order of magnitude relative to P_n^(alpha,beta), taking into account the known finite relation Q_n + a_n Q_{n-1} + b_n Q_{n-2} = P_n^(alpha,beta) + c_n P_{n-1}^(alpha,beta) + d_n P_{n-2}^(alpha,beta).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Fix parameters $\alpha, eta>-1$ and let $d\mu_{\alpha, eta}(x)=(1-x)^\alpha(1+x)^ eta\,dx$ on $(-1,1)$ be the Jacobi weight. Define the non-discrete Sobolev inner product
$$\langle f,gangle_S=\int_{-1}^{1} f(x)g(x)\,d\mu_{\alpha, eta}(x)+\int_{-1}^{1} f'(x)g'(x)\,d\mu_{\alpha, eta}(x),$$
and let $\{Q_n\}_{n\ge 0}$ be the sequence of monic polynomials orthogonal with respect to $\langle\cdot,\cdotangle_S$, with $\deg Q_n=n$. Let $\{P_n^{(\alpha, eta)}\}_{n\ge 0}$ denote the monic Jacobi polynomials orthogonal with respect to $d\mu_{\alpha, eta}$. It is known that there exist sequences of real numbers $a_n,b_n,c_n,d_n$ such that for all $n\ge 2$
$$Q_n(x)+a_n Q_{n-1}(x)+b_n Q_{n-2}(x)=P_n^{(\alpha, eta)}(x)+c_n P_{n-1}^{(\alpha, eta)}(x)+d_n P_{n-2}^{(\alpha, eta)}(x).$$
Determine pointwise and uniform size estimates for $Q_n(x)$ on (and outside) the interval $[-1,1]$, and identify their precise order of magnitude relative to the Jacobi polynomials $P_n^{(\alpha, eta)}(x)$ as $n	o\infty$.
artifact.status_search_result: Significant progress on this problem has been made in the literature: inner and outer strong asymptotics, Mehler–Heine type formulas, asymptotics of zeros, and Sobolev-norm estimates for non-discrete Jacobi–Sobolev orthogonal polynomials have been obtained in several works. However, fully sharp pointwise estimates establishing the precise order of magnitude of $Q_n$ relative to $P_n^{(\alpha,\beta)}$ in all regimes do not appear to be definitively settled, so the problem is best regarded as partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Asymptotic Properties of Orthogonal Polynomials with Respect to a Non-discrete Jacobi-Sobolev Inner Product
status_evidence.snippet: Inner strong asymptotics on (-1,1), Mehler-Heine type formulas, and estimates of the Sobolev norms have been obtained.
status_evidence.claim: Substantial asymptotic results for non-discrete Jacobi-Sobolev orthogonal polynomials have been established.

status_evidence.title: Jacobi–Sobolev orthogonal polynomials: Asymptotics and a Cohen type inequality
status_evidence.snippet: Mehler-Heine-type formula, inner strong asymptotics, upper bounds in various norms of Jacobi-Sobolev orthonormal polynomials.
status_evidence.claim: Upper-bound estimates and asymptotics relating Jacobi-Sobolev polynomials to Jacobi polynomials are available.
